About Leone

Leone has been making some of the finest sweets in Italy since 1857. Luigi Leone opened his first shop in Alda, Piedmont to sell digestive pastilles. Today Leone continues to make sweets using the finest Italian ingredients. They stay rooted in Luigi’s original goal: 'to bring small moments of happiness to those who savour their products'.

BomBom Korean BBQ sauce has a sweet and spicy flavour. It’s perfect for dipping, drizzling and Asian-inspired marinades. The bold Korean flavours are a great match for grilled meat.

This K-BBQ sauce has layers of umami-rich flavour. It gets its heat from gochujang, a fiery Korean chilli paste. There’s a hint of zingy ginger and savoury notes from garlic and soy sauce. Tomato paste and pear purée deliver natural sweetness.
